datasets.title: The Southern Ring in the near infrared
datasets.description: ESA/Webb's picture of the Southern Ring Nebula, NIRCam at 0.90, 1.87, 2.12, 3.56, 4.05 and 4.70 µm: ionised gas in blue, molecular hydrogen in orange. It lies at the depths the gas was measured at: Monteiro et al. (2025) turned velocity cubes of the nebula into its density, a speed standing for a depth. On each sight line the nearer half of the gas's emission and the farther half each stand at their own middle, and the picture's light is shared between the two.
datasets.summary: Webb's picture at the depths its gas was measured at: the nearer and farther halves of each sight line's emission.
